meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 当你问 X 上人们在说什么时,Claude 会用它连接的 x_search 工具去搜 X(推特):给时效性查询加日期范围、限定你信任的账号、按账号和关键词拆成 2~3 次搜索,并把结果和网页搜索对照;每条结论都附上对应的 x.com 链接。
howto.when: 当你提到“X search”、“Twitter search”、“tweets”等关键词,或想查 X 上的风向时触发。前提是已连接 xAI 账号;没有凭据时 x_search 不可用,会明确告知并回退到网页搜索。

say.text: 搜下 X 上最近关于 NVDA 的讨论,只看我信任的那几个账号
say.note: 会分账号和关键词两次搜索并附链接

say.text: 看看 X 上昨天对这次财报的反应,顺便和网页新闻对一下
say.note: 会限定到昨天并同轮跑网页搜索对照

say.text: 把这条 x.com 推文的回复和引用抓出来
say.note: 会执行一次抓回复与引用的查询

howto.what_en: When you ask what people are saying on X, Claude uses the x_search tool: it date-bounds sensitive queries, splits into 2-3 searches by account and keyword, scopes trusted handles, and reconciles with web_search, citing x.com URLs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention “X search”, “Twitter search”, “tweets” or ask what people are saying on X. Requires a connected xAI account; without credentials it falls back to web_search.

say_en.text: Search X for recent posts about NVDA, only from the accounts I trust
say_en.note: Runs a handle pass plus a keyword pass, with links.

say_en.text: See how X reacted to yesterday's earnings, and cross-check web news
say_en.note: Date-bounded search plus a web_search comparison.

say_en.text: Pull the replies and quotes for this x.com post
